customers_say: Customers give positive feedback about the water purifier's appearance, taste, and TDS display feature. However, the product's reliability and value for money receive mixed reviews, with some saying it works well while others report it completely stops working and consider it a money waste. Installation experiences are mixed, with some finding it quick while others experience delays. Moreover, the TDS monitoring receives negative feedback, with one customer reporting TDS levels remain around 22 even after purification. Additionally, several customers report water leakage issues.

reviews.author: Abhi Kumar
reviews.title: Good buy
reviews.body: Good product and good service done

reviews.author: S P
reviews.title: Pure water
reviews.body: I have just bought the equipment. On first glance, built quality is ok. It comes with an RO FILTER which is not required for my area. Anyone buying online please check your TDS level of water before buying. I will update on the product once I fully use it. Presently I am rating it 4 star because after receiving the item even for 2day on one came for installation. I had to call customer care of Amazon and only then the process started. I lost 4days due to this.
